hard_rule: This graph is a review structure, not legal advice and not a tax advice engine.
policy: Every node and every edge is status=under_review, active=false, legal_verified=false. source_ids resolve to registry source_ids only — never to summaries/_extracted/ or any derived file. relationship_basis is 'official_source' when archived official bytes support the link, and 'product_interpretation' when the link is our product design. Neither sets legal_verified.
precedence: raw_sources/ + MANIFEST.json SHA-256 is authoritative; summaries/_extracted/ is derived text.
